+# .claude/data/floor.yaml — the one tracked floor source (cycle-129 SDD D-9.2, DEC-0166).
+#
+# The floor is the set of guards, config keys and files no profile, knob or
+# cycle task may weaken. Readers:
+#   - .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh and tests/unit/guard-origins.bats: the
+#     `floor: true` rows of .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml equal floor_guards.
+#   - tests/unit/floor-snapshot.bats: every floor_files entry (and the corpus
+#     rows named under floor_corpus) is byte-identical to origin/main.
+#   - tests/unit/profile-floor.bats (Sprint 2): profiles.yaml names no floor_keys.
+# Both bats suites pin this file's sha256; an edit fails until the pin is
+# deliberately updated in the same change (see the FLOOR_SHA256 constant).
+schema_version: 1
+
+floor_guards:
+  - fence:FR-1.2b
+  - fence:FR-SZ
+  - fence:FR-SZ-COPY
+  - fence:FR-SZ-DD
+  - fence:FR-SZ-EXTRACT
+  - fence:FR-SZ-INPLACE
+  - fence:FR-SZ-INTERP
+  - fence:FR-SZ-LINK
+  - fence:FR-SZ-REDIR
+  - fence:FR-SZ-TEE
+  - fence:FR-SZ2
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-COPY
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-INPLACE
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-REDIR
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-RM
+  - fence:FR-SZ2-TEE
+  - gate:verdict-derive
+  - gate:adversarial-review-gate
+  - policy:permission-deny-list
+  - policy:verdict-one-way-rule
+  - policy:operator-only-commands
+
+floor_keys:
+  - flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled
+  - flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled
+  - "flatline_protocol.*.companion_voice"
+  - "destructive_command_guard.*"
+  - "implement_gate.*"
+  - hounfour.locality
+
+# Paths whose bytes must not change relative to origin/main during a cycle.
+floor_files:
+  - .claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh
+  - .claude/hooks/safety/adversarial-review-gate.sh
+  - .claude/hooks/settings.deny.json
+  - .claude/data/user-invoked-commands.txt
+
+# Fence-corpus rows (by their `rule` field) that must not change relative to
+# origin/main. A trailing `*` is a prefix match.
+floor_corpus:

+  rules:

+    - "FR-SZ*"

@@ -0,0 +1,905 @@
+# .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml — the guard origin map (cycle-129 SDD D-1.1, §3.1).
+#
+# The one hand-written input of the guard register. `.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh`
+# enumerates the guards from the repository (hook commands in .claude/settings.json,
+# `# @guard fence:<id>` markers in block-destructive-bash.sh, `# @guard validator:<id>`
+# markers in validate-artifact.sh) and fails (exit 5) when one has no row here, when a
+# row here resolves to nothing, or when a row's origin is empty. It then writes the
+# tracked structural register grimoires/loa/guards.md and the untracked host yield
+# .run/guard-yield.{md,json}. Regenerate after editing: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh --hooks-table
+#
+# Row fields:
+#   id             hook:<path under .claude/hooks> (scripts outside it: hook:scripts/<name>),
+#                  fence:<pattern id>, validator:<type>.<rule>, gate:<name>, policy:<name>;
+#                  ^[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]+$
+#   kind           hook | fence | validator | gate | policy
+#   class          harness (the model cannot override it) | script (a script checks or
+#                  reports) | prose (the model is asked to comply)
+#   status         active | dormant (armed only by the env var named in knob) |
+#                  telemetry (observes and logs, never refuses)
+#   origin         {kind: kf|issue|finding|cycle|design, ref: <non-empty>}; design rows
+#                  cite the commit that added the guard (git log --follow --diff-filter=A)
+#   knob           the config key or env var that arms, relaxes or disables it, or none
+#   floor          true exactly for the ids in .claude/data/floor.yaml floor_guards
+#   registrations  hook rows: every "<Event>:<matcher>" (or "<Event>" when the
+#                  registration has no matcher) from .claude/settings.json; [] otherwise
+#   script         gate and policy rows: the file that implements it (must exist)
+#   note           one line; the hooks-reference table's Purpose column for hook rows
+schema_version: 1
+guards:
+  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks
+  - id: hook:scripts/upgrade-health-check.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v1.5.0 692aa617"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["Setup"]
+    note: "Post-install and post-upgrade health check of the framework mount"
+  - id: hook:scripts/check-updates.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v0.14.0 1f448140"}
+    knob: update_check.enabled
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Notify when a newer framework release exists (cached; LOA_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 silences it)"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-l6-surface-handoffs.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-098 FR-L6 (#771)"}
+    knob: structured_handoff.enabled
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Surface unread L6 structured handoffs inside a data fence"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-l7-surface-soul.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-098 FR-L7"}
+    knob: soul_identity_doc.enabled
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Surface the L7 soul identity document inside a data fence"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-run-mode-session-title.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-114 FR-9"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Set the session title from the run-mode state for recovery"
+  - id: hook:loa-kf-surface.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-115"}
+    knob: known_failures.surface_at_session_start
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Print the known-failures symptom table at session start (default off)"
+  - id: hook:hook-guard.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: harness
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: issue, ref: "#1180"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart", "PreToolUse:Bash", "PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit", "PreToolUse:Skill"]
+    note: "Parse-guard wrapper: runs bash -n on the wrapped hook and fails a broken one open instead of bricking the tool"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-decisions-surface.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-128"}
+    knob: decisions.surface_at_session_start
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Default off: up to ten proposed or open decision rows inside the L6 data fence, plus a stale unattended-marker notice"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-run-state-surface.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-125 FR-3"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "One Run line when a run is HALTED or INTERRUPTED or RUNNING idle 12h+, plus a session-limit-reset line; silent otherwise"
+  - id: hook:session-start/loa-context-class.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: cycle, ref: "cycle-126 FR-3.1"}
+    knob: LOA_CONTEXT_CLASS
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["SessionStart"]
+    note: "Write .run/context-class (long by default, standard for a 200K-or-less model) for the context-discipline thresholds; silent, never blocks"
+  - id: hook:pre-compact-marker.sh
+    kind: hook
+    class: script
+    status: active
+    origin: {kind: design, ref: "v1.28.0 dd8f6bf4 (#181)"}
+    knob: none
+    floor: false
+    registrations: ["PreCompact"]
+    note: "Save a marker before compaction"
+  - id: hook:post-compact-reminder.sh

diff --git a/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md b/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md
index a6e116bf..b3a69cf6 100644
--- a/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md
+++ b/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md
@@ -50,11 +50,15 @@ ## Language
 **Jack in**: To start an autonomous run under run mode; a run that has finished or been stopped for good has jacked out.
 _Aliases_: jack out
 
+**Judgment**: The task kind for work that needs reading and a decision; it ships as prose or a reviewed artifact, and its sprint task line ends with kind: judgment.
+
 **Kaironic**: Stopping at the right moment rather than after a fixed count: an iterative review loop ends when successive passes stop finding material issues.
 _Avoid_: converged
 
 **Karpathy principles**: The four working rules applied on every code-touching turn: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes and goal-driven verification.
 
+**Kind counts**: The release-notes line that counts a cycle's sprint tasks by kind (mechanical, judgment and operator), read from the tagged task lines of its sprint plan.
+
 **Known failure**: A recorded degradation with its symptom, the attempts made and a reading guide, consulted before triage so that prior dead ends are not retried.
 _Aliases_: KF
 
@@ -62,6 +66,10 @@ ## Language
 
 **Map epic**: The epic bead that parents an effort's decision tickets, paired with a map document of its destination, decisions so far, fog and exclusions; run mode never implements it.
 
+**Mechanical**: The task kind for work a script could do reliably; it ships as code with tests, and a review flags a mechanical task delivered as prose the model re-executes.
+
+**Operator**: The human who owns the project and its decisions; as a task kind, work that belongs to that human, which a review flags when it was completed unattended without a decision:unblock ticket or a DEC row.
+
 **Round**: One frontier of interview questions asked together and answered together.
 
 **Run mode**: Unattended execution of a sprint plan with a circuit breaker, wrapping implement, review and audit in a loop. Its states are running, halted and jacked out.
@@ -78,4 +86,6 @@ ## Language
 
 **Voice**: The party a decision or finding is attributed to: the operator, the agent, Flatline or dissent.
 
+**Volume ratio**: The release-notes line that sets a cycle's script lines changed against its prose bytes changed and its model calls; the model-call count is local to the host that ran the cycle.

 # Git Stash Safety
 
 `git stash push / pop` wraps are risky inside Loa skill execution: pre-commit hooks run their own internal `git stash --keep-index`, an overlapping outer stash shifts the indexes, and `pop` can land on the wrong entry. Combined with output-swallowing (`| tail -N`, `|| true`, `2>/dev/null`) this produces silent data loss that looks like success.

 # Git Stash Safety
 
 `git stash push / pop` wraps are risky inside Loa skill execution: pre-commit hooks run their own internal `git stash --keep-index`, an overlapping outer stash shifts the indexes, and `pop` can land on the wrong entry. Combined with output-swallowing (`| tail -N`, `|| true`, `2>/dev/null`) this produces silent data loss that looks like success.

# Rewrites the marker block of $HOOKS_REF into $2 (exit 3 when the markers are absent or repeated).
render_hooks_ref() {
    local block="$1" dest="$2" nb ne
    [[ -f "$HOOKS_REF" && -r "$HOOKS_REF" ]] || die 3 "hooks reference not readable: $HOOKS_REF"
    nb="$(grep -c '^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$' "$HOOKS_REF" || true)"
    ne="$(grep -c '^<!-- guard-register:end -->$' "$HOOKS_REF" || true)"
    [[ "$nb" == "1" && "$ne" == "1" ]] \
        || die 3 "$HOOKS_REF needs exactly one <!-- guard-register:begin --> and one <!-- guard-register:end --> line (found $nb and $ne)"
    awk -v blockfile="$block" '
      /^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$/ { while ((getline l < blockfile) > 0) print l; skip = 1; next }

# Heredoc classification: the FR-6 classifier when present (heredoc_nonexec <command>
# returns 0 for a heredoc whose consumer does not execute it), else `<<` presence.
NONEXEC_IDX='null'
if [[ -f "$HEREDOC_LIB" ]] && grep -q '^heredoc_nonexec[[:space:]]*()' "$HEREDOC_LIB"; then
    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    if source "$HEREDOC_LIB" 2>/dev/null && declare -F heredoc_nonexec >/dev/null; then
        IDX_FILE="$TMPWORK/nonexec.idx"
        : > "$IDX_FILE"
        # Same row indexing as the join below: non-blank lines, in order. Commands travel base64-encoded.
        while IFS="$US" read -r idx b64; do
            [[ -n "$idx" ]] || continue
            cmd="$(printf '%s' "$b64" | base64 --decode 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$b64" | base64 -D 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if heredoc_nonexec "$cmd" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' "$idx" >> "$IDX_FILE"; fi
        done < <(jq -R -n -r '[inputs | select(test("\\S")) | (try fromjson catch null)] | to_entries[]
                   | select((.value | type) == "object" and .value.action == "block" and ((.value.command // "") | tostring | contains("<<")))
                   | "\(.key)\u001f\(.value.command | tostring | @base64)"' "$ROWS" 2>/dev/null)
        NONEXEC_IDX="$(jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0) | tonumber)' "$IDX_FILE")"
    fi
fi

YIELD_JSON="$(jq -R -n \

    --argjson hooks "$HOOKS_JSON" \
    --argjson nonexec "$NONEXEC_IDX" \

    --argjson win "$WINDOW_DAYS" \
    --argjson segs "$N_SEGMENTS" \
    --argjson burst_rows "$BURST_ROWS" \
    --arg tmp "$TMP_PREFIX" \
    --arg root "$ROOT" \
    --arg mainroot "$MAIN_ROOT" '
  def epoch: (.ts // .timestamp // null) | if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
  def under($r): . as $c | ($r != "") and ($c == $r or ($c | startswith($r + "/")));
  def minute: (.ts // .timestamp // "") | tostring | .[0:16];
  def replay($burst): (.replay == true)
    or ((.cwd // "") | type == "string" and (startswith($tmp) or contains("/bats-run-") or contains("/bats.") or contains("/evals/results/") or contains("/sandbox/")))
    or (minute | IN($burst[]));
  def outside_repo: (.cwd // "") as $c | ($c | type == "string") and $c != "" and (($c | under($root)) or ($c | under($mainroot)) | not);
  def verbs: ["rm","git","find","dd","mkfs","shred","truncate","kubectl","terraform","aws","gcloud","psql","mysql","DROP","DELETE","TRUNCATE"];
  def destructive_start: (.command // "") | tostring | [splits("(;|&&|\\|\\||\\||\n)")] | map(sub("^\\s+"; "") | (split("\\s+"; null)[0] // "")) | any(.[]; IN(verbs[]));
  def heredoc: if $nonexec == null then ((.command // "") | tostring | contains("<<")) else (._i | IN($nonexec[])) end;
  def prose_class: (.pattern_id // "") | IN("SP-1", "FR-MERGE-2", "FR-2-AMBIGUOUS");
  def likely_fp: heredoc or outside_repo or (prose_class and (destructive_start | not));
  def day: strftime("%Y-%m-%d");

  | ($map.guards | map(.id)) as $known
  | [inputs | select(test("\\S")) | (try fromjson catch null)] as $raw
  | ($raw | to_entries | map(.value as $v | if ($v | type) == "object" then ($v + {_i: .key}) else null end)) as $all
  | ($all | map(select(. != null))) as $rows
  | ($rows | length) as $read
  | ($rows | map(select(.action == "block" or .hook == "implement-gate") | . + {_t: epoch})) as $cand
  | ($cand | map(select(._t != null and ._t >= ($now - $win * 86400) and ._t <= ($now + 86400)))) as $inwin
  | ($inwin | map(select(.action == "block" and .replay != true)) | group_by(minute)
     | map(select(length >= $burst_rows) | .[0] | minute)) as $burst
  | ($inwin | map(select(replay($burst) | not))) as $live
  | ($live | map(
      (if .hook == "block-destructive-bash" then
         ["hook:safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"] + (if ((.pattern_id // "") | tostring | test("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$")) then ["fence:" + .pattern_id] else [] end)
       elif .hook == "implement-gate" then ["hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh", "gate:implement-gate"]
       elif ((.hook // "") | type) == "string" and $hookid[.hook] != null then [$hookid[.hook]]
       else [] end) as $ids
      | {ids: ($ids | map(select(IN($known[])))),
         block: (.action == "block" or .action == "deny"),
         telemetry: (.action == "telemetry" or .action == "ask"),
         fp: ((.action == "block" or .action == "deny") and likely_fp),
         t: ._t})) as $cls
  | ($cls | map(.ids[]) | unique) as $seen
  | (["hook:safety/block-destructive-bash.sh", "hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh", "gate:implement-gate"]
     + ($map.guards | map(select(.kind == "fence") | .id)) + $seen | unique) as $writers
  | ($map.guards | map(. as $g
      | if ($g.id | IN($writers[])) then
          ($cls | map(select(any(.ids[]; . == $g.id)))) as $mine
          | ($mine | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | map(.t) | max) as $last
          | {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: true,
             blocks_30d: ($mine | map(select(.block)) | length),
             likely_fp_30d: ($mine | map(select(.fp)) | length),
             telemetry_30d: ($mine | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
             last_real_catch: (if $last == null then "none in window" else ($last | day) end)}
        else
          {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: false,
           blocks_30d: null, likely_fp_30d: null, telemetry_30d: null, last_real_catch: "n/a"}
        end)) as $guards
  | {
      schema_version: 1,
      generated_at: ($now | day),
      window_days: $win,
      scope: "host",
      audit_segments: $segs,
      audit_rows_read: $read,
      audit_rows_unparseable: (($raw | length) - $read),
      audit_rows_considered: ($inwin | length),
      replay_rows_excluded: (($inwin | length) - ($live | length)),
      replay_rows_by_rule: {
        flag: ($inwin | map(select(.replay == true)) | length),
        cwd: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and replay([]))) | length),
        burst: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and (replay([]) | not) and replay($burst))) | length)
      },
      heuristic: "likely_fp = heredoc in the command OR cwd outside the repository OR (pattern SP-1, FR-MERGE-2 or FR-2-AMBIGUOUS with no destructive verb at statement start); real = block AND NOT likely_fp",
      totals: {
        guards: ($map.guards | length),
        guards_without_origin: 0,
        dormant: ($map.guards | map(select(.status == "dormant")) | length),
        blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block)) | length),
        real_blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | length),
        likely_fp_30d: ($cls | map(select(.fp)) | length),
        telemetry_30d: ($cls | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
        unattributed_30d: ($cls | map(select(.ids | length == 0)) | length)
      },
      guards: $guards
    }

        exit 1
    fi
    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: in sync ($N_GUARDS guards)"
    exit 0
fi

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- yield
SEGMENTS="$TMPWORK/segments"
: > "$SEGMENTS"
for f in "$AUDIT_LOG" "$AUDIT_LOG".*; do
    [[ -e "$f" ]] || continue
    [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || die 3 "audit log segment not readable: $f"
    printf '%s\n' "$f" >> "$SEGMENTS"
done
N_SEGMENTS="$(wc -l < "$SEGMENTS" | tr -d ' ')"
ROWS="$TMPWORK/audit.rows"
: > "$ROWS"
if [[ "$N_SEGMENTS" == "0" ]]; then
    warn "no audit log at $AUDIT_LOG (or segments $AUDIT_LOG.*); the yield is empty"
else
    while IFS= read -r f; do cat -- "$f" >> "$ROWS"; printf '\n' >> "$ROWS"; done < "$SEGMENTS"
fi

TMP_PREFIX="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
TMP_PREFIX="${TMP_PREFIX%/}/"
MAIN_ROOT=""
if common="$(cd "$ROOT" && git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)"; then
    common="$(cd "$ROOT" && cd "$common" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || common=""
    case "$common" in */.git) MAIN_ROOT="${common%/.git}" ;; esac
fi

# Heredoc classification: the FR-6 classifier when present (heredoc_nonexec <command>
# returns 0 for a heredoc whose consumer does not execute it), else `<<` presence.
NONEXEC_IDX='null'
if [[ -f "$HEREDOC_LIB" ]] && grep -q '^heredoc_nonexec[[:space:]]*()' "$HEREDOC_LIB"; then
    # shellcheck source=/dev/null
    if source "$HEREDOC_LIB" 2>/dev/null && declare -F heredoc_nonexec >/dev/null; then
        IDX_FILE="$TMPWORK/nonexec.idx"
        : > "$IDX_FILE"
        # Same row indexing as the join below: non-blank lines, in order. Commands travel base64-encoded.
        while IFS="$US" read -r idx b64; do
            [[ -n "$idx" ]] || continue
            cmd="$(printf '%s' "$b64" | base64 --decode 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$b64" | base64 -D 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if heredoc_nonexec "$cmd" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s\n' "$idx" >> "$IDX_FILE"; fi
        done < <(jq -R -n -r '[inputs | select(test("\\S")) | (try fromjson catch null)] | to_entries[]
                   | select((.value | type) == "object" and .value.action == "block" and ((.value.command // "") | tostring | contains("<<")))
                   | "\(.key)\u001f\(.value.command | tostring | @base64)"' "$ROWS" 2>/dev/null)
        NONEXEC_IDX="$(jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0) | tonumber)' "$IDX_FILE")"
    fi
fi

YIELD_JSON="$(jq -R -n \
    --argjson map "$MAP_JSON" \
    --argjson hooks "$HOOKS_JSON" \
    --argjson nonexec "$NONEXEC_IDX" \
    --argjson now "$NOW_EPOCH" \
    --argjson win "$WINDOW_DAYS" \
    --argjson segs "$N_SEGMENTS" \
    --argjson burst_rows "$BURST_ROWS" \
    --arg tmp "$TMP_PREFIX" \
    --arg root "$ROOT" \
    --arg mainroot "$MAIN_ROOT" '
  def epoch: (.ts // .timestamp // null) | if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
  def under($r): . as $c | ($r != "") and ($c == $r or ($c | startswith($r + "/")));
  def minute: (.ts // .timestamp // "") | tostring | .[0:16];
  def replay($burst): (.replay == true)
    or ((.cwd // "") | type == "string" and (startswith($tmp) or contains("/bats-run-") or contains("/bats.") or contains("/evals/results/") or contains("/sandbox/")))
    or (minute | IN($burst[]));
  def outside_repo: (.cwd // "") as $c | ($c | type == "string") and $c != "" and (($c | under($root)) or ($c | under($mainroot)) | not);
  def verbs: ["rm","git","find","dd","mkfs","shred","truncate","kubectl","terraform","aws","gcloud","psql","mysql","DROP","DELETE","TRUNCATE"];
  def destructive_start: (.command // "") | tostring | [splits("(;|&&|\\|\\||\\||\n)")] | map(sub("^\\s+"; "") | (split("\\s+"; null)[0] // "")) | any(.[]; IN(verbs[]));
  def heredoc: if $nonexec == null then ((.command // "") | tostring | contains("<<")) else (._i | IN($nonexec[])) end;
  def prose_class: (.pattern_id // "") | IN("SP-1", "FR-MERGE-2", "FR-2-AMBIGUOUS");
  def likely_fp: heredoc or outside_repo or (prose_class and (destructive_start | not));
  def day: strftime("%Y-%m-%d");
  def origin_txt: .origin as $o | if ($o.ref | tostring | startswith($o.kind | tostring)) then ($o.ref | tostring) else "\($o.kind) \($o.ref)" end;
  ($hooks | map({key: (.rel | split("/") | last | sub("\\.sh$"; "")), value: .id}) | from_entries) as $hookid
  | ($map.guards | map(.id)) as $known
  | [inputs | select(test("\\S")) | (try fromjson catch null)] as $raw
  | ($raw | to_entries | map(.value as $v | if ($v | type) == "object" then ($v + {_i: .key}) else null end)) as $all
  | ($all | map(select(. != null))) as $rows
  | ($rows | length) as $read
  | ($rows | map(select(.action == "block" or .hook == "implement-gate") | . + {_t: epoch})) as $cand
  | ($cand | map(select(._t != null and ._t >= ($now - $win * 86400) and ._t <= ($now + 86400)))) as $inwin
  | ($inwin | map(select(.action == "block" and .replay != true)) | group_by(minute)
     | map(select(length >= $burst_rows) | .[0] | minute)) as $burst
  | ($inwin | map(select(replay($burst) | not))) as $live
  | ($live | map(
      (if .hook == "block-destructive-bash" then
         ["hook:safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"] + (if ((.pattern_id // "") | tostring | test("^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$")) then ["fence:" + .pattern_id] else [] end)
       elif .hook == "implement-gate" then ["hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh", "gate:implement-gate"]
       elif ((.hook // "") | type) == "string" and $hookid[.hook] != null then [$hookid[.hook]]
       else [] end) as $ids
      | {ids: ($ids | map(select(IN($known[])))),
         block: (.action == "block" or .action == "deny"),
         telemetry: (.action == "telemetry" or .action == "ask"),
         fp: ((.action == "block" or .action == "deny") and likely_fp),
         t: ._t})) as $cls
  | ($cls | map(.ids[]) | unique) as $seen
  | (["hook:safety/block-destructive-bash.sh", "hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh", "gate:implement-gate"]
     + ($map.guards | map(select(.kind == "fence") | .id)) + $seen | unique) as $writers
  | ($map.guards | map(. as $g
      | if ($g.id | IN($writers[])) then
          ($cls | map(select(any(.ids[]; . == $g.id)))) as $mine
          | ($mine | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | map(.t) | max) as $last
          | {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: true,
             blocks_30d: ($mine | map(select(.block)) | length),
             likely_fp_30d: ($mine | map(select(.fp)) | length),
             telemetry_30d: ($mine | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
             last_real_catch: (if $last == null then "none in window" else ($last | day) end)}
        else
          {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: false,
           blocks_30d: null, likely_fp_30d: null, telemetry_30d: null, last_real_catch: "n/a"}
        end)) as $guards
  | {
      schema_version: 1,
      generated_at: ($now | day),
      window_days: $win,
      scope: "host",
      audit_segments: $segs,
      audit_rows_read: $read,
      audit_rows_unparseable: (($raw | length) - $read),
      audit_rows_considered: ($inwin | length),
      replay_rows_excluded: (($inwin | length) - ($live | length)),
      replay_rows_by_rule: {
        flag: ($inwin | map(select(.replay == true)) | length),
        cwd: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and replay([]))) | length),
        burst: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and (replay([]) | not) and replay($burst))) | length)
      },
      heuristic: "likely_fp = heredoc in the command OR cwd outside the repository OR (pattern SP-1, FR-MERGE-2 or FR-2-AMBIGUOUS with no destructive verb at statement start); real = block AND NOT likely_fp",
      totals: {
        guards: ($map.guards | length),
        guards_without_origin: 0,
        dormant: ($map.guards | map(select(.status == "dormant")) | length),
        blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block)) | length),
        real_blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | length),
        likely_fp_30d: ($cls | map(select(.fp)) | length),
        telemetry_30d: ($cls | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
        unattributed_30d: ($cls | map(select(.ids | length == 0)) | length)
      },
      guards: $guards
    }
' "$ROWS")" || die 3 "the audit log could not be joined"

render_yield_md() {
    jq -r "$JQ_DEFS"'
      def n: if . == null then "n/a" else tostring end;
      . as $y
      | "# Guard yield (host)",
        "",
        "<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh; untracked, host-local. The structural register is grimoires/loa/guards.md. -->",
        "",
        "- generated_at: \($y.generated_at)",
        "- window_days: \($y.window_days)",
        "- scope: \($y.scope)",
        "- audit_segments: \($y.audit_segments)",
        "- audit_rows_considered: \($y.audit_rows_considered)",
        "- replay_rows_excluded: \($y.replay_rows_excluded) (flag \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.flag), cwd \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.cwd), burst \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.burst))",
        "- audit_rows_unparseable: \($y.audit_rows_unparseable)",
        "- totals: \($y.totals.real_blocks_30d) real blocks, \($y.totals.likely_fp_30d) likely FP, \($y.totals.telemetry_30d) telemetry, \($y.totals.unattributed_30d) unattributed",
        "- heuristic: \($y.heuristic | cell)",
        (kinds[] as $k | ($y.guards | map(select(.kind == $k))) as $rows | select($rows | length > 0)
          | "",
            "## \($k) (\($rows | length))",
            "",
            "| id | class | status | origin | knob | floor | registrations | blocks_30d | likely_fp_30d | telemetry_30d | last_real_catch |",
            "|----|-------|--------|--------|------|-------|---------------|------------|---------------|---------------|-----------------|",
            ($rows[] | "| \(.id | cell) | \(.class | cell) | \(.status | cell) | \(.origin | cell) | \(.knob | cell) | \(.floor | yesno) | \(regs) | \(.blocks_30d | n) | \(.likely_fp_30d | n) | \(.telemetry_30d | n) | \(.last_real_catch | cell) |"))
    ' <<<"$YIELD_JSON"
}

YIELD_MD_NEW="$TMPWORK/guard-yield.md"
YIELD_JSON_NEW="$TMPWORK/guard-yield.json"
render_yield_md > "$YIELD_MD_NEW"
jq '.' <<<"$YIELD_JSON" > "$YIELD_JSON_NEW"

install_file "$REGISTER_NEW" "$OUT"
install_file "$YIELD_MD_NEW" "$YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.md"
install_file "$YIELD_JSON_NEW" "$YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.json"
if (( DO_HOOKS_TABLE )); then
    render_hooks_ref "$HOOKS_BLOCK" "$HOOKS_REF_NEW"
    cmp -s "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF" || install_file "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF"
fi

summary="$(jq -r '"\(.totals.guards) guards (\(.totals.dormant) dormant); \(.window_days) d: \(.totals.real_blocks_30d) real blocks, \(.totals.likely_fp_30d) likely FP, \(.replay_rows_excluded) replay rows excluded; scope host"' <<<"$YIELD_JSON")"
if (( DO_JSON )); then
    cat "$YIELD_JSON_NEW"
    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: wrote $OUT and $YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.{md,json}: $summary" >&2
else
    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: wrote $OUT and $YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.{md,json}: $summary"
fi
exit 0

# optional trailing range keeps `file.py:10-14` in one token, and the comma
# list after it (`:776,807`) belongs to the same path. A bare `:N` (or
# `head:N` / `base:N`) not glued to a word binds to the most recent path.
# a range dash is unspaced (`a.sh:12 - 40 rows` is prose, not a range) and
# every number ends at a boundary: no letter or digit, and no hyphen / en dash
# before another digit, after it (dates such as 2026-10-05 / 2026–10–05 never
# parse; an open `:369-...` still cites 369) — sprint-250 review run 2, #13
RNG = r'(\d{1,6})(?:[-–](\d{1,6}))?(?![A-Za-z0-9]|[-–]\d)'
CITE = re.compile(
    r'(?P<path>[A-Za-z0-9_./+()-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6})[`*)]{0,3}:(?P<first>' + RNG
    + r'(?:[ \t]*,[ \t]*' + RNG + r')*)'
    # head:N / base:N keep the 1.1.0 boundary set ("head:40" binds); the JSON
    # punctuation set, plus a CLOSING backtick (one after a token character:
    # `rows`:40, `"high"`:3), guards only the fully bare :N — an opening
    # backtick (`:7`, (`:212`)) still binds (RG-13) — run 2, #14
    r'|(?:(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:])(?:head|base)|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:"\'{}\[\]*])(?<![A-Za-z0-9_"\'}\]]`)):(?P<bare>' + RNG + r')')
ONE = re.compile(RNG)
cites = []
last = None
# the trailer is machine output (its counts are read below), never a citation.
# One pattern strips and reads it (tolerant whitespace, line breaks); the body
# may not contain another comment's `<!--` or `-->`, so an unterminated
# `<!-- LOA-VERDICT` strips nothing — sprint-250 review run 2, #15
TRAILER = re.compile(r'<!--\s*LOA-VERDICT\s*(\{(?:(?!<!--|-->).)*\})\s*-->', re.S)
body = TRAILER.sub('', text)
URL = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://|^//')
for m in CITE.finditer(body):
    if m.group("path") is not None:
        # a URL (https://h/x.js:8080, //host.com:8080) is not a path, nor is a
        # partial match that starts later inside the URL token
        # (https://u@h.com/x.js:8080 matches `h.com/x.js`) — run 2, #11
        # the token so far is the window's text after its last whitespace —
        # one linear split ("" when the window ends in whitespace); `\S*$`
        # also matched before a final newline, so a line-leading citation
        # inherited the previous line's URL, and was O(k^2) — run 3
        tok = re.split(r'\s', body[max(0, m.start() - 4096):m.start()])[-1] + m.group("path")
        if "//" in m.group("path") or URL.search(tok):

        p = m.group("path").lstrip("(")
        if p.startswith("./"):
            p = p[2:]
        last, spans = p, m.group("first")
    elif last is not None:
        p, spans = last, m.group("bare")
    else:
        continue
    for r in ONE.finditer(spans):
        a = int(r.group(1)); b = int(r.group(2)) if r.group(2) else a
        if b < a:

    if cited == defect_file or defect_file.endswith("/" + cited):
        return True
    return cited == defect_file.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]

for d in man.get("defects", []):
    sites = d.get("anchors") or [d["anchor_line"]]
    hit = any(path_matches(p, d["file"]) and not (b < s - 3 or a > s + 3)
              for p, a, b in cites for s in sites)
    (detected if hit else missed).append(d["id"])

planted = len(man.get("defects", []))
recall = round(len(detected) / planted, 4) if planted else None

# refuted share (1.2.0): distinct cited findings that touch no defect site and
# no fix region. Regions are (file, lo, hi) on head/ line numbers, widened ±3.
regions = []
for d in man.get("defects", []):
    for s in (d.get("anchors") or [d["anchor_line"]]):
        regions.append((d["file"], s - 3, s + 3))
for fr in man.get("fix_regions", []) or []:
    try:
        regions.append((fr["file"], int(fr["start"]) - 3, int(fr["end"]) + 3))
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
        continue
findings = sorted(set(cites))
refuted = [c for c in findings
           if not any(path_matches(c[0], f) and not (c[2] < lo or c[1] > hi) for f, lo, hi in regions)]
refuted_share = round(len(refuted) / len(findings), 4) if findings else None

sev = None
tm = TRAILER.search(text)
if tm:
    try:
        sev = json.loads(tm.group(1)).get("counts")

@@ -0,0 +1,393 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
+
+Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
+suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
+<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
+`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
+
+Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
+the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
+findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
+findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
+bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
+the verdict and the missed labels.
+
+Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
+  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
+                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
+                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
+                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
+                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
+  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
+                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
+  no recall loss  every rule holds:
+                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
+                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
+                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
+An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
+
+Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
+given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
+"""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import json
+import os
+import random
+import sys
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+
+
+def load_yaml_subset(path):
+    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
+    import subprocess
+    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
+    return json.loads(out)
+
+
+def read_jsonl(path):
+    rows = []
+    if not os.path.isfile(path):
+        return rows
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        for line in fh:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if line:
+                try:
+                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
+                except ValueError:
+                    continue
+    return rows
+
+
+def mean(xs):
+    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
+    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
+
+
+def fmt(x, nd=3):
+    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
+
+
+def recall_details(row):
+    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
+        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
+            return g["details"]
+    return None
+
+
+def tokens(row):
+    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
+    if not u:
+        return None
+    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
+               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
+
+
+def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
+    if not sorted_xs:
+        return None
+    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
+    return sorted_xs[k]
+
+
+def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
+    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
+    if not deltas:
+        return None, None
+    rng = random.Random(seed)
+    n = len(deltas)
+    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
+    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
+    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
+
+
+class Arm:
+    def __init__(self, arm_id):
+        self.id = arm_id
+        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
+        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
+        self.cited = 0
+        self.refuted = 0
+        self.tokens = []
+        self.models = set()
+        self.sources = set()
+        self.done = 0
+        self.errors = 0
+        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
+        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
+        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
+        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
+
+    def add(self, row):
+        if row.get("status") != "completed":
+            self.errors += 1
+            return
+        d = recall_details(row)
+        if d is None:
+            self.errors += 1
+            return
+        self.done += 1
+        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
+        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
+        if d.get("recall") is not None:
+            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
+        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:

+        t = tokens(row)

+        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
+        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
+        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
+            if out:
+                self.models.add(mid)
+        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
+        if fb:
+            self.fallback_trials += 1
+            for x in fb:
+                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
+        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
+        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
+            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
+            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+
+    def defect_fixtures(self):
+        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
+
+    def fixture_means(self):
+        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
+
+    def trial_means(self):

+        for f in self.defect_fixtures():

+    def refuted_share(self):

+
+def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):

+    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))

+

+"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
+
+Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
+suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
+<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
+`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
+
+Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
+the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
+findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
+findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
+bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
+the verdict and the missed labels.
+
+Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
+  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
+                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
+                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
+                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
+                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
+  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
+                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
+  no recall loss  every rule holds:
+                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
+                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
+                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
+An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
+
+Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
+given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
+"""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import json
+import os
+import random
+import sys
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+
+
+def load_yaml_subset(path):
+    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
+    import subprocess
+    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
+    return json.loads(out)
+
+
+def read_jsonl(path):
+    rows = []
+    if not os.path.isfile(path):
+        return rows
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        for line in fh:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if line:
+                try:
+                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
+                except ValueError:
+                    continue
+    return rows
+
+
+def mean(xs):
+    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
+    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
+
+
+def fmt(x, nd=3):
+    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
+
+
+def recall_details(row):
+    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
+        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
+            return g["details"]
+    return None
+
+
+def tokens(row):
+    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
+    if not u:
+        return None
+    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
+               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
+
+
+def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
+    if not sorted_xs:
+        return None
+    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
+    return sorted_xs[k]
+
+
+def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
+    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
+    if not deltas:
+        return None, None
+    rng = random.Random(seed)
+    n = len(deltas)
+    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
+    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
+    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
+
+
+class Arm:
+    def __init__(self, arm_id):
+        self.id = arm_id
+        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
+        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count

+        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
+        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
+

+            if out:

+            for x in fb:
+                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1

+        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
+            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
+            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
+
+    def defect_fixtures(self):
+        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
+
+    def fixture_means(self):
+        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
+
+    def trial_means(self):
+        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
+        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
+            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
+                by_trial[t].append(r)
+        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
+
+    def refuted_share(self):
+        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None
+
+
+def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
+    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
+    status = {}
+    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
+    if os.path.isfile(sp):
+        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))

+    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
+    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
+    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
+    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
+    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
+
+    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
+    arms = {}
+    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
+        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
+        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
+        if not os.path.isfile(mp):

+        if m.get("dry_run"):

+    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
+    complete = state == "complete"
+
+    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
+    out_lines.append("")
+    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
+    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
+    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
+#
+# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
+# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
+# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
+#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
+#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
+#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
+#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
+#
+# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
+#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
+#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
+#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
+#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
+#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
+#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
+#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
+#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
+#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
+#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
+#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
+#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
+#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
+#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
+#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
+#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
+#
+# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
+#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
+#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
+#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
+#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
+#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
+#
+# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
+#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
+#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
+#
+# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
+# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
+# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail
+export LC_ALL=C
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+EVALS_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/evals"
+CORPUS_DIR="$EVALS_DIR/fixtures/review-prs"
+DEFAULT_MODEL="claude-fable-5-1"
+CACHE_ROOT="${LOA_ARMS_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/loa/cycle-129}"
+# the repository the pinned source worktree is cut from (tests point it at a
+# throwaway repo so they never register a worktree in the real one)
+SOURCE_REPO="${LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO:-$REPO_ROOT}"
+
+SUITE="" ARMS_CSV="" FIXTURES_CSV="" TRIALS="" SOURCE_COMMIT="" MODEL="$DEFAULT_MODEL"
+CONCURRENCY=2 BATCH="" RESULTS_ROOT="$EVALS_DIR/results/arms" RETRY_WAIT=300
+DRY_RUN=false ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=false
+
+usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,46p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
+die() { echo "run-arms: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
+
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --suite) SUITE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --arms) ARMS_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --fixtures) FIXTURES_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --trials) TRIALS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --source-commit) SOURCE_COMMIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --model) MODEL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --concurrency) CONCURRENCY="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --batch) BATCH="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --results-dir) RESULTS_ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --retry-wait) RETRY_WAIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
+    --allow-unapproved) ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=true; shift ;;
+    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
+    --help|-h) usage ;;
+    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
+  esac
+done
+
+# --- validate arguments ------------------------------------------------------
+case "$SUITE" in review-recall|audit-recall) ;; *) die "--suite must be review-recall or audit-recall" ;; esac
+[[ "$TRIALS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]?$ ]] || die "--trials must be an integer 1-99"
+[[ "$CONCURRENCY" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "--concurrency must be 1-9"
+[[ "$RETRY_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] || die "--retry-wait must be whole seconds"
+[[ "$MODEL" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$ ]] || die "--model has unexpected characters"
+[[ "$SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] || die "--source-commit must be a hex commit id"
+for tool in git jq yq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
+
+SUITE_FILE="$EVALS_DIR/suites/$SUITE.yaml"
+[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
+TASK_PREFIX="review"; [[ "$SUITE" == "audit-recall" ]] && TASK_PREFIX="audit"
+
+IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"
+IFS=',' read -r -a FIXTURES <<<"$FIXTURES_CSV"
+[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "--arms is required"
+[[ ${#FIXTURES[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${FIXTURES[0]}" ]] || die "--fixtures is required"
+for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
+  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
+  [[ "$(A="$a" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(A))] | length' "$SUITE_FILE")" -gt 0 ]] \
+    || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE (ab.arms[])"
+done
+for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
+  [[ "$f" =~ ^pr-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || die "invalid fixture id '$f' (want pr-NN)"
+  [[ -d "$CORPUS_DIR/$f" ]] || die "fixture not found: $CORPUS_DIR/$f"
+  [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json" ]] || die "hidden manifest not found for $f"
+  [[ -f "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml"
+  if [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("approved") then .approved else true end' "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json")" != "true" \
+        && "$ALLOW_UNAPPROVED" != "true" ]]; then
+    die "$f: labels.tsv is not approved yet (seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve $f --by '<who> <date>'), or pass --allow-unapproved"
+  fi
+done
+
+SRC_FULL="$(git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${SOURCE_COMMIT}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)" \
+  || die "source commit $SOURCE_COMMIT is not in this repository"
+SRC12="${SRC_FULL:0:12}"
+WORKTREE="$CACHE_ROOT/arms-src-$SRC12"
+
+[[ -n "$BATCH" ]] || BATCH="batch-${FIXTURES[0]}-${FIXTURES[${#FIXTURES[@]}-1]}-n${#FIXTURES[@]}"
+[[ "$BATCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$ ]] || die "invalid --batch '$BATCH'"
+SUITE_DIR="$RESULTS_ROOT/$SUITE"
+BATCH_DIR="$SUITE_DIR/$BATCH"
+
+# --- corpus freeze ------------------------------------------------------------
+# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
+# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
+verify_corpus() {
+  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
+import hashlib, os, sys
+corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
+raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
+bad = []
+for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
+    if not line.strip():
+        continue
+    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
+    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
+                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
+        continue
+    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
+    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
+        bad.append(rel)
+if bad:
+    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
+    sys.exit(1)
+print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
+PY
+}
+CORPUS_DIGEST="$(verify_corpus)" || die "fixture corpus does not match SHA256SUMS (run build/seed with --check first)"
+
+# --- the planned trials (interleaved: trial-major, then fixture, then arm) ----
+PLAN=()

+
+json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }
+
+write_manifest() {  # write_manifest <path> <dry_run>
+  local out="$1" dry="$2" claude_bin="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" cli_version
+  cli_version="$("$claude_bin" --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo unknown)"
+  local harness_commit harness_dirty=false
+  harness_commit="$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"

+  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
+  jq -n \
+    --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg batch "$BATCH" \
+    --arg source_commit "$SRC_FULL" --arg source_worktree "$WORKTREE" \
+    --arg harness_commit "$harness_commit" --argjson harness_dirty "$harness_dirty" \
+    --arg model_id "$MODEL" --arg cli "$claude_bin" --arg cli_version "$cli_version" \
+    --argjson trials "$TRIALS" --argjson concurrency "$CONCURRENCY" --argjson retry_wait "$RETRY_WAIT" \
+    --argjson per_trial "$per_trial" --arg max_turns "${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}" \
+    --argjson arms "$(json_array "${ARMS[@]}")" --argjson fixtures "$(json_array "${FIXTURES[@]}")" \
+    --argjson planned "${#PLAN[@]}" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" \
+    --arg os "$(uname -srm)" --arg bash_v "$BASH_VERSION" \
+    --arg jq_v "$(jq --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg yq_v "$(yq --version 2>/dev/null)" \

+    --arg created "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson dry "$dry" \

+      arms: $arms, fixtures: $fixtures, trials: $trials, trials_planned: $planned,
+      corpus: {manifest: "evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS", sha256: $digest,
+               verified: "every entry before the batch; the fixture'"'"'s entries before each trial"},
+      environment: {os: $os, bash: $bash_v, jq: $jq_v, yq: $yq_v, python: $py_v, git: $git_v}}' > "$out.tmp"

+if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then

+
+CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"

+
+# --- the pinned source worktree -------------------------------------------------
+mkdir -p "$CACHE_ROOT"

+

+    || die "batch $BATCH already holds results for source $prev_src / model $prev_model; use another --batch"

+  for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
+    per="$(jq -c --arg a "${ARMS[$i]}" --argjson d "${DONE[$i]}" --argjson f "${FAILED[$i]}" --argjson p "${PLANNED[$i]}" \
+      '. + {($a): {trials_done: $d, trials_failed: $f, trials_planned: $p}}' <<<"$per")"
+  done
+  [[ "$STATE" != "running" ]] && finished="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
+  jq -n --arg state "$STATE" --argjson per "$per" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model "$MODEL" \
+    --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" \
+    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
+      source_commit: $src, model_id: $model, started: $started, finished: $finished}' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
+  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
+  aggregate_status
+}
+
+# The suite-level STATUS.json merges every batch: counters add per arm; the
+# state is failed > running > partial > complete; source/model must agree.
+aggregate_status() {
+  local agg="$SUITE_DIR/STATUS.json" lockd="$SUITE_DIR/.status.lock" n=0
+  until mkdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null; do n=$((n + 1)); [[ $n -gt 50 ]] && return 0; sleep 0.1; done
+  # shellcheck disable=SC2046
+  jq -s --arg suite "$SUITE" '
+    def rank: {"failed": 4, "running": 3, "partial": 2, "complete": 1}[.] // 4;
+    (map(.state) | max_by(rank)) as $state |
+    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,
+     batches: map({batch, state, started, finished}),
+     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};
+        .[$e.key] |= {trials_done: ((.trials_done // 0) + $e.value.trials_done),
+                      trials_failed: ((.trials_failed // 0) + $e.value.trials_failed),
+                      trials_planned: ((.trials_planned // 0) + $e.value.trials_planned)})),
+     source_commit: (map(.source_commit) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
+     model_id: (map(.model_id) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
+     started: (map(.started) | min), finished: (if $state == "running" then null else (map(.finished) | max) end)}' \
+    $(find "$SUITE_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name STATUS.json | sort) > "$agg.tmp" 2>/dev/null \
+    && mv "$agg.tmp" "$agg"
+  rmdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null || true
+}
+set_state() { STATE="$1"; write_status; }
+
+# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
+is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
+  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
+  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
+  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
+  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
+  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
+  grep -qiE 'rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|network|socket hang up|5[0-9][0-9] ' \
+    "$err" "$out" 2>/dev/null && return 0
+  return 1
+}
+
+run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
+  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
+  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
+  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
+  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
+  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
+  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
+  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
+  if ! verify_corpus "$fx" >"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift"; then
+    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
+  fi
+  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
+    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
+    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
+    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
+      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
+    ex_rc=0
+    EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
+      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
+      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
+        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
+        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
+    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
+    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
+      local gout gexit=0
+      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
+        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
+      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then
+        graders="$(jq -c '.graders' <<<"$gout")"; composite="$(jq -c '.composite' <<<"$gout")"
+      fi
+      if [[ $gexit -le 1 ]]; then status="completed"; err_json='null'
+      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
+      break
+    fi
+    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 1 ]] && is_transport_failure "$ws"; then
+      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$attempt" '{type:"transport_error",message:"executor transport failure",attempt:$a}')"
+      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
+        keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" "-attempt1"
+        "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+        ws=""; executor='null'
+        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
+      fi
+    else
+      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson rc "$ex_rc" '{type:(if $rc == 2 then "infrastructure_error" else "agent_error" end),message:("execute-agent exit " + ($rc|tostring))}')"
+    fi
+    break
+  done
+  end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
+  if [[ -n "$ws" && -d "$ws" ]]; then
+    keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" ""
+    "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+  jq -cn --arg run_id "$run_id" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg task_id "$task_id" \
+    --arg fixture "$fx" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson trial "$trial" --argjson attempts "$attempt" \
+    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
+    --argjson duration_ms "$(( end_ms - start_ms ))" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model_req "$MODEL" \
+    --argjson executor "$executor" --argjson graders "$graders" --argjson composite "$composite" \
+    --argjson error "$err_json" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" --arg digest_now "$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>/dev/null)" \
+    '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, batch: $batch, suite: $suite, task_id: $task_id, fixture: $fixture,
+      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
+      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
+      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
+      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}
+     + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor: $executor} end)' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp"
+  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"
+}
+
+keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
+  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
+  mkdir -p "$dest"
+  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do
+    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/$f" "$dest/$f"
+  done
+  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
+  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
+  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
+collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
+  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
+  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
+  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
+    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
+    set_state failed; exit 3
+  fi
+  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
+    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
+    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
+    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
+      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
+      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
+    else
+      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
+      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
+    fi
+    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
+  else
+    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
+    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
+  fi
+  write_status
+}
+
+log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
+write_status
+trap 'log "interrupted"; set_state failed; exit 3' INT TERM HUP
+
+PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
+reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
+  local i
+  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
+    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
+      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
+        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
+        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
+        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
+        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
+        break
+      fi
+    done
+    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
+  done
+  return 0
+}
+
+n=0
+for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
+  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
+  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
+  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
+  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
+  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
+done
+reap 1
+
+total_done=0 total_failed=0
+for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done
+if [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then
+  set_state complete; log "complete: $total_done trials"; exit 0
+elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
+  set_state failed; log "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"; exit 3
+else
+  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1
+fi
